[{"signature":"auto_assert_automation_identity(bigint,bigint,text,text)","definition":"CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auto_assert_automation_identity(p_staff_id bigint, p_organization_id bigint, p_auth_username text, p_auth_password text)\n RETURNS void\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n STABLE SECURITY DEFINER\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE\n  v_claim_role text;\n  v_claims jsonb;\nBEGIN\n  v_claim_role := NULLIF(current_setting('request.jwt.claim.role', true), '');\n\n  IF v_claim_role IS NULL THEN\n    BEGIN\n      v_claims := NULLIF(\n        current_setting('request.jwt.claims', true),\n        ''\n      )::jsonb;\n      v_claim_role := NULLIF(v_claims ->> 'role', '');\n    EXCEPTION\n      WHEN OTHERS THEN\n        v_claim_role := NULL;\n    END;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_claim_role IS NULL THEN\n    v_claim_role := NULLIF(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '');\n  END IF;\n\n  IF v_claim_role = 'service_role' THEN\n    RETURN;\n  END IF;\n\n  IF p_auth_username IS NULL OR p_auth_password IS NULL THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'automation_auth_required';\n  END IF;\n\n  IF NOT EXISTS (\n    SELECT 1\n    FROM public.org_staff AS staff\n    WHERE staff.id = p_staff_id\n      AND staff.organization_id = p_organization_id\n      AND staff.is_active = true\n      AND staff.username = p_auth_username\n      AND staff.password = p_auth_password\n  ) THEN\n    RAISE EXCEPTION 'automation_auth_invalid';\n  END IF;\nEND;\n$function$\n","owner":"postgres","prosecdef":true,"provolatile":"s","proconfig":["search_path=pg_catalog, public"],"proacl":"{postgres=X/postgres,service_role=X/postgres}","checksum":"5a9a503db72b965eb644739f5f60905d"}]
